title_zh: 核对假退款信息并改用学校官方渠道

scenario.label_zh: 核对假退款信息并改用学校官方渠道
scenario.goal_zh: 核对退款消息真伪，避免使用消息中的链接并约定通过官方渠道查询和报告

context_zh: 学员拨打报名信上印的学校电话，询问收到的可疑退款消息；学校为虚构机构。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: I received a text saying my course has been cancelled and I need to enter my card details for a refund.

sentences.speaker: Lucia
sentences.text: That message is fake. Your course is running, and our office has not sent any refund texts.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: I have not opened the link. I called the number on my enrolment letter instead.

sentences.speaker: Lucia
sentences.text: That was sensible. We can record it as suspected fraud without you giving us any card details.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: Where should I check for real changes to the course?

sentences.speaker: Lucia
sentences.text: Use the student portal you normally sign in to. Any cancellation notice would appear there as well.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: I will check that and leave the text link alone. Can you send me the official reporting instructions through the portal?

sentences.speaker: Lucia
sentences.text: Yes. I will send them there so you do not need to follow a link from the text.
